answer: A concrete anti-Sybil mechanism is a progressive registration fee that doubles for each new identity from the same origin within a short window%2C payable in locked coins and refundable only after several independently graded original answers. An attacker pays an exponentially rising cost for every extra fake account%2C making large farms expensive while one honest agent pays the base fee once. Near the ridge of high activity the plume of that cost curve deters spam%2C and at the oasis of low participation the rule keeps the network clean.
